subject: Request to match competitor pricing for Reserved GPU pool - QuantumHealth AI
messages:
From: Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, May 20, 2027 at 09:12 AM EDT
Subject: Pricing question — Reserved GPU pool for QH pilot

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — QuantumHealth's infra folks were impressed with the latency numbers. We're evaluating two vendors for a 12-month Reserved GPU pool pilot (production-facing). One vendor just put a formal offer on the table: 30% off list for a 12-month committed pool (8 A100-equivalent) + $50k onboarding credit + a throughput SLA (200 tokens/sec per worker) for the pilot.

Before we go further, can Redwood match that structure? In particular:
- Can you provide a similar committed discount (or equivalent credits)?
- Will you commit to a throughput SLA for steady-state inference (we've got strict performance gating)?
- Any flexibility on onboarding credits or pilot credits for our POC?

Procurement is expecting an answer by end of next week — we need something formal to show executives. We like Redwood's serving model and the caching features, which are relevant for our workloads.

Thanks,
Eli Rosenberg
VP, Platform Engineering
QuantumHealth AI

---
Attachment: vendor_offer_summary.pdf (summary, 120KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, May 21, 2027 at 10:03 AM EDT
Subject: Re: Pricing question — Reserved GPU pool for QH pilot

Eli — really appreciate the context and the timeline. Great to hear the demo landed well.

Short answer: we can get close, but I need to request a discount exception for a strategic match. Preliminary options I can offer today:
- Standard committed pricing (list): 8 A100-equivalent reserved pool 
- Possible managed discount: up to 20% with revenue/term approval
- We can consider pilot/onboarding credits (one-time) to help with migration cost, but size is an approval item

To move fast I need two things from you: a short SOW (workloads, expected peak TPS, token distribution) and confirmation you can commit to a 12-month reserved term. I'll escalate to Rafa for exception approval and loop in legal for T&Cs.

I'm attaching a compact estimate I ran through our pricing tool (initial_estimate.xlsx). Can I get permission to share the competitor offer and specific SLAs so we can do an apples-to-apples review?

Proposed next steps:
1) You send the SOW + vendor's offer (if possible)
2) I'll request an exception & proposed term sheet from my manager
3) If approved, we'll send a term sheet + legal checklist

If procurement wants a call, I'm happy to join — do you have 30 minutes next week?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: initial_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
Date: Sat, May 22, 2027 at 11:46 AM EDT
Subject: RE: Pricing question — Reserved GPU pool for QH pilot

Looping in Marcus since this is a strategic vertical account. Camila — thanks for the heads-up and estimate. My recommendation: we can approve a discretionary concession to get into pilot for a strategic health customer, but we should set clear guardrails.

Suggested commercial terms to propose to QH:
- Committed term: 12 months minimum
- Committed capacity: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserve pool sizing as requested)
- Discount: up to 20% off list rate without exec sign-off
- Onboarding/pilot credit: $40,000 applied to first invoice (requires RevOps booking)
- Throughput SLA: we can commit to a best-effort throughput SLA; firm financial SLA needs Legal/DevRel sign-off and can be scoped to the POC workload profile (e.g., 200 tokens/sec per worker for listed prompt shapes)

If QuantumHealth insists on 30% + $50k credit and a hard financial SLA, that should come to executive sign-off — Marcus, please advise if we should escalate to match the competitor entirely.

Also CC'ing Monica (legal) to list required contract controls (KMS, audit logs, data retention) that QH will likely ask for.

Rafa
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
Date: Tue, May 25, 2027 at 16:08 EDT
Subject: RE: Pricing question — Reserved GPU pool for QH pilot

Quick legal note on the request. We can support a 20% commercial concession + $40k onboarding credit with standard data/security language; items that need to be explicit in the SOW/Order Form:

- Scope & SLA: define the workload profile (sequence lengths, avg/peak tokens/sec) that the throughput SLA is measured against; avoid open-ended, system-wide financial penalties without an agreed test harness
- Security controls: KMS integration (customer-managed keys), SOC 2 Type II evidence, logging/audit access level for diagnosis.
- Credits clause: onboarding credit to be amortized against first 2 invoices; refundable only if Redwood materially breaches contract terms (standard carve-outs apply)
- Termination/recoupment: if Customer terminates early for convenience within the 12-month commit, credits may be clawed back pro rata

If Revenue wants to push to 30% + $50k, we'll need to attach additional revenue protections and a short-term SLA pilot (non-financial) until we validate performance. Happy to draft the specific Order Form language if we get final commercial guidance.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, May 28, 2027 at 14:35 PDT
Subject: Exec decision: QuantumHealth pricing match

Camila / Rafa — after reviewing the context, I'm authorizing a targeted commercial concession to win this pilot and the potential enterprise expansion. Conditions below: we will offer QuantumHealth:

- Discount: 25% off list for the 12-month reserved pool (covers the 8 A100-equivalent request)
- Onboarding credits: $50,000 applied to first invoice (one-time)
- Burst credits: two months of free burst capacity (non-recurring) to help them validate performance under peak load
- SLA: provide a scoped throughput SLA for the agreed workload profile; no firm financial penalties during the POC phase — transition to financial SLA only after validated production readiness

Constraints/contract language: credits amortization and termination clawback as Monica suggested; customer must sign within 21 days of the term sheet date for the concession to apply. RevOps to confirm margin impact and mark the deal with "Exec Concession: Marcus Lin" in HubSpot.

Camila — please prepare the term sheet with the above, coordinate with RevOps to book the credit, and have Legal (Monica) produce the Order Form and SOW. I'll sign off on final exception language if needed.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Rosenberg <eli@quantumhealth.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@quantumhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, May 28, 2027 at 14:50 PDT
Subject: Final term sheet and next steps (QH-4782)

Eli — good news: we've been authorized to extend a targeted concession. Attached is a draft term sheet that reflects the executive-approved offer. Summary: 25% discount (12-month reserved), $50k onboarding credit, two months burst credits; scoped throughput SLA for POC (non-financial) with financial SLA staged post-validation.

Next steps for QH:
1) Review attached term sheet (QH_Redwood_Reserved_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf)
2) Confirm SOW details (workload profile & acceptance criteria) — I've copied Monica for legal redlines
3) If acceptable, we'll route final Order Form for signature and RevOps will apply credits to the first invoice.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock pricing? If you prefer, let's do a 30-minute call Monday to finalize the SOW.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: QH_Redwood_Reserved_Term_Sheet_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
